scope: Fresh behavioural evidence only. Full certification stopped on confirmed FBE2E L27; all mutation work interrupted, not certified.

assertions.title: PROFILE-INGRESS refuses an old HANDOFF at HTTP/typed/internal ingress and direct dispatch, with zero signer, turn, consumption or owner effect
PROFILE-EGRESS refuses new/mixed HANDOFF mint and suppresses every old mixed control from resolve without rewriting history
PROFILE-GRANT passes allowed navigation through scope admission, rejects old grants, and rolls back a failed binding
PROFILE-LOCK serializes concurrent revoke with an in-flight profile admission under the existing AR-1 lock
PROFILE-BOOKING admits the actual HTTP catalog → selectors → DRAFT → COMMIT source under a signed restricted grant
PROFILE-SOURCE NS admits only the exact new source under a signed restricted grant
PROFILE-SOURCE BS admits only the exact new source under a signed restricted grant
AR1-LIFECYCLE validate is read-only; signed grant has atomic audit; same authorization retry never grants twice; revoke refuses an old widget token
AR1-CONCURRENT two consumes of one authorization produce one grant and one audit
AR1-STALE two independently signed grants with the same prestate cannot both win CAS
AR1-AUDIT failure rolls back the entitlement mutation
AR1-EXPIRY expires without renewal and denies the old authorization
AR1-ADVERSARIAL forged, expired, tenant-substituted and rebound authorizations have no grant effect
AR1-SUSPENDED rollback remains available after a tenant is suspended
AR1-ROLE tenant owner and revoked platform session never gain release authority
AR1-REVOKE-WAIT active admitted work and revoke serialize on the tenant release lock
NS-CHECK admits exact detail date and preserves REFINE; all near-miss shapes remain forbidden
NS-REFUSE date cannot project a historical source
NS-REFUSE erased cannot project a historical source
NS-REFUSE expired cannot project a historical source
NS-REFUSE body cannot project a historical source
NS-REFUSE seal cannot project a historical source
NS-REFUSE foreign-principal cannot project a historical source
NS-PARENT rechecks parent availability when the new exact return link is used
SV2-01 happy successor verification creates usable explicit personal context and actual actor audit
SV2-02 wrong OTP has no link or consumption effect
SV2-03 replay fails closed
SV2-04 expired OTP fails under database time
SV2-05 Client substitution cannot transfer a challenge
SV2-06 tenant substitution fails closed
SV2-07 predecessor changed after resolver read is rejected inside identity lock
SV2-08 active predecessor never authorizes issuance or consumption
SV2-09 non-latest revoked predecessor cannot be consumed
SV2-10 revoked episode remains byte-for-byte immutable
SV2-11 successful consume creates exactly one successor and one outcome
SV2-12 concurrent consume serializes to one success and one refusal
SV2-JSON all four V2 fields are mandatory, exact and immutable
SV2-CHANNEL canonical channel changed after issuance invalidates exact Client proof
SV2-SESSION current revocation is checked on consume
SV2-LIMIT failed OTP attempts survive rollback and cannot be reset with correct code
SV2-DELIVERY failed SMS grants nothing and discloses no OTP
SV2-V1 historical V1 remains immutable and initial-only; V1 consumption still works for a fresh subject
SV2-HTTP registered authenticated route refuses caller authority and consumes real V2 coordinator
TURN-ORDINARY persists exactly one USER row on concurrent same-request retries and carries its conversation forward
TURN-WIDGET uses the same persisted writer for production-minted typed and tapped controls; expired retry never falls through to ordinary chat
TURN-ERASURE refuses replay of an erased row without restoring content or extending retention
TURN-ATOMIC rolls back the USER row when its immutable correlation cannot be committed
TURN-READ keeps an actual chat read, its widget emission and the next typed widget turn in one conversation
TURN-SCOPE refuses a foreign current actor or tenant conversation; request IDs alone never confer identity
TURN-BROKEN-BINDING refuses duplicate evidence, orphan rows and expired history without recreating either half
AR-G6-REVOCATION [E-MINT] real post-Gate6 revoke refuses at canonical admission and increments metric
TURN-CANONICAL [HTTP] [E-MINT] ordinary typed, widget typed and native tap persist byte-identical USER content through the same writer
BS-SOURCE [HTTP] [E-MINT] own-list exact Client source proposes and commits reschedule and cancel through existing owners
NS-SOURCE [HTTP] [E-MINT] production journal detail rereads exact retained date and resolves exact parent
